en.headline: Apartment fire on Milan's Piazzale Udine
en.subheadline: Woman and dogs rescued; a cigarette is suspected as the cause.

body.text: A fire broke out in an apartment building on Piazzale Udine, with the alarm sounding towards 8 a.m., according to Corriere della Sera.
MilanoToday reported the alarm around 8.30 a.m. on Saturday.
Firefighters rescued a woman and her dog, and ANSA added that two dogs were also saved.
The cause is thought to be a lit cigarette, and seven fire squads were on site.
The rescued woman was taken to the Città Studi hospital.

why_it_matters.text: If a discarded cigarette is indeed the source, the incident could underline the danger of careless smoking in residential areas.

key_facts.text: Alarm sounded towards 8 a.m.; seven fire squads responded.
One woman and at least one dog were rescued; the woman is hospitalized.
